reaction: The shared meal is a quiet, fitting ending, though it was a straightforward combination.

mostWorthwhile.text: Installing the local delivery display was most worthwhile: the Tin Row rider finding the workshop showed the address working in practice.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making breakfast was predictable: the noodles and broth obviously went together, with little decision involved.

surprise.text: The local display included a request-desk call button, while explicitly leaving Meridian's policy unchanged. That distinction made its usefulness clearer.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless; the offered combinations had clear connections to the goals, even when predictable.

continue.text: I would probably continue for the community story and practical infrastructure details, though the predictable compatible-choice menu makes the gameplay itself less compelling.
